purpose: Replace the WLL G4 reviewed exclusions and stale pre-Kodiak February anchors with an exact post-acquisition issuer share count from a public SEC Form 8-K filed before every affected target cutoff.
corporate_action_context: Whiting's December 8, 2014 Kodiak acquisition is already reflected in this explicit outstanding-share total.
evidence_notes: Item 8.01 explicitly states that as of December 31, 2014 the Company had 166,889,152 common shares outstanding.
The filing explicitly states that this amount takes into account shares issued in the Kodiak acquisition.
The source was public more than a month before all February 2015 WLL target cutoffs; no arithmetic reconstruction or inference is used.
